name: Christmas Gift Shooter
description: Get into the holiday spirit with this Christmas Gift Shooter game! Shoot gifts until there are none left on the screen. Like Bubble Shooter, this game is easy to learn but difficult to master. See how high of a score you can get before the clock runs out! Make this holiday season one to remember with the Christmas Gift Shooter game! This festive take on the classic bubble shooter genre is sure to get you into the holiday spirit. So put on your best Santa hat, sit back, and enjoy shooting some holiday gifts!
